english: Replace ObservableObject with the @Observable macro.

english: Add a sensoryFeedback modifier to trigger haptics on state change.

translations.pt-BR: Adicione um modifier sensoryFeedback pra disparar haptics quando o estado muda.

english: The new MeshGradient lets us build organic backgrounds in pure SwiftUI.
context: Discussing visual design using SwiftUI 2026 gradient API

translations.pt-BR: O novo MeshGradient permite criar backgrounds orgânicos em SwiftUI puro.

english: Mark this function async so we can await the network call.

translations.pt-BR: Marque essa função como async pra podermos dar await na chamada de rede.
translations.es: Marca esta función como async para poder hacer await en la llamada de red.
translations.fr: Marque cette fonction async pour pouvoir await l'appel réseau.

translations.it: Segna questa funzione come async per poter fare await sulla chiamata di rete.

english: Wrap mutable state inside an actor to make it Sendable.

translations.pt-BR: Envolva o estado mutável dentro de um actor pra torná-lo Sendable.
translations.es: Envuelve el estado mutable dentro de un actor para hacerlo Sendable.

translations.it: Incapsula lo stato mutabile dentro un actor per renderlo Sendable.

english: Enable strict concurrency checking before migrating to Swift 6.

translations.pt-BR: Ative strict concurrency checking antes de migrar pro Swift 6.
translations.es: Activa el strict concurrency checking antes de migrar a Swift 6.
translations.fr: Active la vérification stricte de concurrence avant de migrer vers Swift 6.

translations.it: Attiva lo strict concurrency checking prima di migrare a Swift 6.

english: Run these requests concurrently with a TaskGroup.
context: Parallelizing async work in Swift

translations.pt-BR: Rode essas requisições concorrentemente com um TaskGroup.

translations.fr: Exécute ces requêtes en parallèle avec un TaskGroup.
translations.de: Führe diese Requests gleichzeitig mit einer TaskGroup aus.
translations.it: Esegui queste richieste in parallelo con un TaskGroup.

english: Mark this type Sendable so it can cross actor boundaries safely.
context: Annotating types for Swift Concurrency safety

translations.pt-BR: Marque esse tipo como Sendable pra poder cruzar fronteiras de actor com segurança.
translations.es: Marca este tipo como Sendable para que pueda cruzar fronteras de actor de forma segura.
translations.fr: Marque ce type Sendable pour qu'il puisse traverser les frontières d'actor en sécurité.
translations.de: Markiere diesen Typ als Sendable, damit er Actor-Grenzen sicher überqueren kann.
translations.it: Segna questo tipo come Sendable per attraversare i confini degli actor in sicurezza.

english: Use @MainActor to guarantee this runs on the main thread.
context: Annotating UI-bound code with the main actor

translations.pt-BR: Use @MainActor pra garantir que isso rode na main thread.
translations.es: Usa @MainActor para garantizar que esto se ejecute en el hilo principal.
translations.fr: Utilise @MainActor pour garantir que ça tourne sur le thread principal.
translations.de: Verwende @MainActor, um sicherzustellen, dass das auf dem Main Thread läuft.
translations.it: Usa @MainActor per garantire che venga eseguito sul main thread.

english: Cancel the task when the view disappears to avoid leaks.
context: Lifecycle management for async tasks in SwiftUI

translations.pt-BR: Cancele a task quando a view desaparecer pra evitar leaks.
translations.es: Cancela la task cuando la vista desaparezca para evitar leaks.
translations.fr: Annule la tâche quand la vue disparaît pour éviter les leaks.
translations.de: Brich die Task ab, wenn die View verschwindet, um Leaks zu vermeiden.
translations.it: Annulla la task quando la view scompare per evitare memory leak.

english: AsyncSequence makes streaming data feel native to Swift.
context: Praising the ergonomics of Swift's async iteration

translations.pt-BR: AsyncSequence faz com que streaming de dados pareça nativo do Swift.
translations.es: AsyncSequence hace que el streaming de datos se sienta nativo de Swift.
translations.fr: AsyncSequence rend le streaming de données vraiment natif en Swift.
translations.de: AsyncSequence lässt Daten-Streaming sich wie natives Swift anfühlen.
translations.it: AsyncSequence fa sembrare nativo lo streaming di dati in Swift.

english: Expose this feature as an App Intent so Siri can trigger it.

translations.pt-BR: Exponha essa funcionalidade como um App Intent pra Siri poder disparar.

translations.pt-BR: Defina um AppShortcutsProvider pra registrar seus shortcuts no momento da instalação.

translations.pt-BR: O parâmetro do intent é resolvido via um dynamic options provider.

translations.fr: Le paramètre de l'intent se résout via un dynamic options provider.
translations.de: Der Intent-Parameter wird über einen Dynamic Options Provider aufgelöst.

english: Add interactive buttons to your widget with App Intents.

translations.pt-BR: Adicione botões interativos no seu widget usando App Intents.
translations.es: Agrega botones interactivos a tu widget usando App Intents.

translations.it: Aggiungi pulsanti interattivi al tuo widget usando gli App Intent.

english: Use @Parameter to declare the inputs your intent expects.

translations.pt-BR: Use @Parameter pra declarar os inputs que seu intent espera.

english: The donate API tells the system this action is worth suggesting.

translations.pt-BR: A API de donate diz pro sistema que essa ação vale a pena ser sugerida.

translations.pt-BR: Localize o display representation do seu intent em todos os idiomas suportados.

translations.pt-BR: A gente tá prototipando um app companion pra visionOS.

translations.it: Selezioneremo le API più impattanti da inserire nella nostra roadmap.

english: Swift Tasks are 200x lighter than threads — you can spawn millions concurrently on a single device.
context: Curiosity about Swift Concurrency runtime cost

translations.pt-BR: Tasks do Swift são 200x mais leves que threads — dá pra criar milhões concorrentes num único device.
translations.es: Las Tasks de Swift son 200x más ligeras que los threads — puedes lanzar millones concurrentes en un solo dispositivo.
translations.fr: Les Tasks Swift sont 200 fois plus légères que les threads — tu peux en lancer des millions en parallèle sur un seul appareil.
translations.de: Swift Tasks sind 200-mal leichter als Threads — du kannst Millionen gleichzeitig auf einem Gerät starten.
translations.it: Le Task di Swift sono 200 volte più leggere dei thread — puoi crearne milioni in concorrenza su un singolo dispositivo.

english: An actor's mailbox processes one message at a time, which is how Swift eliminates data races inside its boundary.
context: Explaining how actor isolation actually works under the hood

translations.pt-BR: A mailbox de um actor processa uma mensagem por vez — é assim que Swift elimina data races dentro da fronteira dele.
translations.es: La mailbox de un actor procesa un mensaje a la vez — así es como Swift elimina las data races dentro de su frontera.
translations.fr: La mailbox d'un actor traite un message à la fois — c'est ainsi que Swift élimine les data races à l'intérieur de sa frontière.
translations.de: Die Mailbox eines Actors verarbeitet eine Nachricht nach der anderen — so eliminiert Swift Data Races innerhalb seiner Grenze.
translations.it: La mailbox di un actor elabora un messaggio alla volta — è così che Swift elimina i data race dentro la sua frontiera.

english: async/await compiles to coroutines under the hood, not callbacks — the stack unwinds and resumes cleanly at each suspension point.
context: How Swift's concurrency model is implemented

translations.pt-BR: async/await compila pra coroutines por baixo, não callbacks — a stack se desfaz e retoma limpa em cada ponto de suspensão.
translations.es: async/await compila a coroutines por debajo, no a callbacks — la pila se desenrolla y reanuda limpia en cada punto de suspensión.
translations.fr: async/await compile vers des coroutines en interne, pas des callbacks — la pile se déroule et reprend proprement à chaque point de suspension.
translations.de: async/await wird intern zu Coroutines kompiliert, nicht zu Callbacks — der Stack rollt sich ab und setzt an jedem Suspendierungspunkt sauber fort.
translations.it: async/await viene compilato in coroutine sotto il cofano, non in callback — lo stack si srotola e riprende pulito a ogni punto di sospensione.

english: MainActor is just a global actor — you can define your own with @globalActor for domain-specific isolation.
context: Building custom actor isolation for a subsystem

translations.pt-BR: MainActor é só um global actor — você pode definir o seu próprio com @globalActor pra isolamento específico de domínio.
translations.es: MainActor es solo un global actor — puedes definir el tuyo con @globalActor para aislamiento específico de dominio.
translations.fr: MainActor n'est qu'un global actor — tu peux définir le tien avec @globalActor pour un isolement spécifique à un domaine.
translations.de: MainActor ist nur ein globaler Actor — du kannst eigene mit @globalActor für domänenspezifische Isolation definieren.
translations.it: MainActor è solo un global actor — puoi definirne uno tuo con @globalActor per un isolamento specifico del dominio.

english: Structured concurrency guarantees child tasks always finish before their parent — no orphans, no leaks.
context: Key safety property of Swift's concurrency model

translations.pt-BR: Concorrência estruturada garante que tasks filhas sempre terminam antes da pai — sem órfãs, sem leaks.
translations.es: La concurrencia estructurada garantiza que las tasks hijas siempre terminan antes que su padre — sin huérfanas, sin leaks.
translations.fr: La concurrence structurée garantit que les tâches enfants terminent toujours avant leur parent — pas d'orphelines, pas de fuites.
translations.de: Strukturierte Concurrency garantiert, dass Child-Tasks immer vor ihrem Parent enden — keine Waisen, keine Leaks.
translations.it: La concorrenza strutturata garantisce che le task figlie finiscano sempre prima della loro madre — niente orfane, niente leak.

english: Sendable is a marker protocol with zero requirements — the compiler checks the entire property graph for thread safety automatically.
context: How the Sendable contract is enforced

translations.pt-BR: Sendable é um marker protocol sem requisitos — o compilador verifica o grafo inteiro de propriedades por thread safety automaticamente.
translations.es: Sendable es un marker protocol sin requisitos — el compilador verifica todo el grafo de propiedades por thread safety automáticamente.
translations.fr: Sendable est un marker protocol sans exigences — le compilateur vérifie tout le graphe de propriétés pour la thread safety automatiquement.
translations.de: Sendable ist ein Marker-Protocol ohne Anforderungen — der Compiler prüft den gesamten Eigenschaftsgraphen automatisch auf Thread-Sicherheit.
translations.it: Sendable è un marker protocol senza requisiti — il compilatore verifica automaticamente l'intero grafo di proprietà per la thread safety.

english: TaskGroup automatically cancels remaining children if any throws — safer than DispatchGroup, which leaks on early exit.
context: Why TaskGroup beats Grand Central Dispatch for parallel work

translations.pt-BR: TaskGroup cancela automaticamente as filhas restantes se alguma lança erro — mais seguro que DispatchGroup, que vaza em saída antecipada.
translations.es: TaskGroup cancela automáticamente las hijas restantes si alguna lanza error — más seguro que DispatchGroup, que filtra en salida temprana.
translations.fr: TaskGroup annule automatiquement les enfants restants si l'une lance — plus sûr que DispatchGroup, qui fuit en sortie précoce.
translations.de: TaskGroup bricht automatisch verbleibende Children ab, wenn eine wirft — sicherer als DispatchGroup, das bei vorzeitigem Beenden leakt.
translations.it: TaskGroup annulla automaticamente le figlie rimanenti se una lancia errore — più sicuro di DispatchGroup, che fa leak in uscita anticipata.

english: Swift Concurrency was introduced in Swift 5.5 in 2021 and became strict-by-default in Swift 6.
context: Brief history of Swift's concurrency model

translations.pt-BR: Swift Concurrency foi introduzido no Swift 5.5 em 2021 e virou strict-by-default no Swift 6.
translations.es: Swift Concurrency se introdujo en Swift 5.5 en 2021 y pasó a ser strict-by-default en Swift 6.
translations.fr: Swift Concurrency a été introduit dans Swift 5.5 en 2021 et est devenu strict-by-default dans Swift 6.
translations.de: Swift Concurrency wurde in Swift 5.5 im Jahr 2021 eingeführt und in Swift 6 zum Standard mit strikter Prüfung.
translations.it: Swift Concurrency è stato introdotto in Swift 5.5 nel 2021 ed è diventato strict-by-default in Swift 6.

english: SwiftUI was announced at WWDC 2019 — its declarative model was inspired by React and Elm.
context: Origin story of SwiftUI

translations.pt-BR: SwiftUI foi anunciado na WWDC 2019 — o modelo declarativo dele foi inspirado em React e Elm.
translations.es: SwiftUI se anunció en la WWDC 2019 — su modelo declarativo se inspiró en React y Elm.
translations.fr: SwiftUI a été annoncé à la WWDC 2019 — son modèle déclaratif s'inspire de React et Elm.
translations.de: SwiftUI wurde auf der WWDC 2019 vorgestellt — sein deklaratives Modell ist von React und Elm inspiriert.
translations.it: SwiftUI è stato annunciato al WWDC 2019 — il suo modello dichiarativo è ispirato a React ed Elm.

english: The @Observable macro replaces ObservableObject by tracking reads at the property level, eliminating unnecessary view re-renders.
context: Why the new Observation framework is faster than Combine

translations.pt-BR: A macro @Observable substitui ObservableObject rastreando leituras no nível de propriedade, eliminando re-renders desnecessários da view.
translations.es: El macro @Observable reemplaza ObservableObject rastreando las lecturas a nivel de propiedad, eliminando re-renders innecesarios de la vista.
translations.fr: Le macro @Observable remplace ObservableObject en suivant les lectures au niveau de la propriété, éliminant les re-renders inutiles de la vue.
translations.de: Das @Observable-Macro ersetzt ObservableObject, indem es Reads auf Property-Ebene verfolgt und unnötige View-Re-Renders eliminiert.
translations.it: Il macro @Observable sostituisce ObservableObject tracciando le letture a livello di proprietà, eliminando i re-render inutili della view.

english: Macros run at compile time and produce Swift code — they're typesafe and visible in the build log unlike runtime reflection.
context: Key distinction between macros and runtime metaprogramming

translations.pt-BR: Macros rodam em tempo de compilação e produzem código Swift — são typesafe e visíveis no build log, ao contrário de reflection em runtime.
translations.es: Los macros se ejecutan en tiempo de compilación y producen código Swift — son typesafe y visibles en el build log, a diferencia del reflection en runtime.
translations.fr: Les macros s'exécutent à la compilation et produisent du code Swift — typesafe et visibles dans le build log, contrairement à la réflexion runtime.
translations.de: Macros laufen zur Compile-Zeit und erzeugen Swift-Code — sie sind typsicher und im Build-Log sichtbar, im Gegensatz zu Runtime-Reflection.
translations.it: I macro vengono eseguiti a tempo di compilazione e producono codice Swift — sono typesafe e visibili nel build log, a differenza della reflection a runtime.

english: Swift macros are written in Swift itself — they manipulate the SwiftSyntax AST as plain values.
context: What macro authoring looks like

translations.pt-BR: Macros do Swift são escritos no próprio Swift — eles manipulam a AST do SwiftSyntax como valores comuns.
translations.es: Los macros de Swift se escriben en el propio Swift — manipulan el AST de SwiftSyntax como valores normales.
translations.fr: Les macros Swift sont écrits en Swift même — ils manipulent l'AST de SwiftSyntax comme des valeurs ordinaires.
translations.de: Swift-Macros werden in Swift selbst geschrieben — sie manipulieren den SwiftSyntax-AST als gewöhnliche Werte.
translations.it: I macro di Swift sono scritti in Swift stesso — manipolano l'AST di SwiftSyntax come valori comuni.

english: Apple Intelligence runs a roughly 3-billion-parameter model on-device — small enough for iPhone 15 Pro and newer.
context: Hardware requirements for on-device LLM features

translations.pt-BR: Apple Intelligence roda um modelo de cerca de 3 bilhões de parâmetros on-device — pequeno o bastante pro iPhone 15 Pro e mais novos.
translations.es: Apple Intelligence ejecuta un modelo de unos 3 mil millones de parámetros on-device — pequeño lo suficiente para iPhone 15 Pro y posteriores.
translations.fr: Apple Intelligence fait tourner un modèle d'environ 3 milliards de paramètres on-device — assez petit pour l'iPhone 15 Pro et plus récents.
translations.de: Apple Intelligence betreibt ein Modell mit rund 3 Milliarden Parametern on-device — klein genug für iPhone 15 Pro und neuer.
translations.it: Apple Intelligence esegue un modello da circa 3 miliardi di parametri on-device — abbastanza piccolo per iPhone 15 Pro e successivi.

english: Foundation Models uses an adapter system to specialize the on-device language model per task without loading a new model.
context: How Apple keeps a single small model versatile

translations.pt-BR: Foundation Models usa um sistema de adapters pra especializar o modelo on-device por tarefa sem carregar um modelo novo.
translations.es: Foundation Models usa un sistema de adapters para especializar el modelo on-device por tarea sin cargar un modelo nuevo.
translations.fr: Foundation Models utilise un système d'adapters pour spécialiser le modèle on-device par tâche sans charger un nouveau modèle.
translations.de: Foundation Models verwendet ein Adapter-System, um das On-Device-Modell pro Aufgabe zu spezialisieren, ohne ein neues Modell zu laden.
translations.it: Foundation Models usa un sistema di adapter per specializzare il modello on-device per ogni task senza caricare un modello nuovo.

english: Guided generation is faster than free generation because it skips invalid tokens at decode time instead of retrying.
context: Why structured LLM output is also a performance win

translations.pt-BR: Guided generation é mais rápida que geração livre porque pula tokens inválidos no decode em vez de tentar de novo.
translations.es: Guided generation es más rápida que la generación libre porque omite tokens inválidos al decodificar en lugar de reintentar.
translations.fr: Guided generation est plus rapide que la génération libre car elle saute les tokens invalides au décodage au lieu de réessayer.
translations.de: Guided Generation ist schneller als freie Generierung, weil sie ungültige Tokens beim Dekodieren überspringt statt erneut zu versuchen.
translations.it: Guided generation è più veloce della generazione libera perché salta i token non validi in fase di decodifica invece di riprovare.

english: Apple's Private Cloud Compute servers are independently auditable — security researchers can verify the full software stack.
context: How Apple Intelligence keeps cloud-assisted prompts private

translations.pt-BR: Os servidores do Private Cloud Compute da Apple são auditáveis de forma independente — pesquisadores de segurança podem verificar a stack inteira.
translations.es: Los servidores Private Cloud Compute de Apple son auditables de forma independiente — los investigadores de seguridad pueden verificar toda la stack.
translations.fr: Les serveurs Private Cloud Compute d'Apple sont auditables de manière indépendante — les chercheurs en sécurité peuvent vérifier toute la stack logicielle.
translations.de: Apples Private-Cloud-Compute-Server sind unabhängig prüfbar — Sicherheitsforscher können den gesamten Software-Stack verifizieren.
translations.it: I server Private Cloud Compute di Apple sono verificabili in modo indipendente — i ricercatori di sicurezza possono ispezionare l'intero stack software.

english: The Vision Pro display packs 23 megapixels per eye — more pixels than a 4K television, inside each lens.
context: Curiosity about Vision Pro hardware specs

translations.pt-BR: O display do Vision Pro tem 23 megapixels por olho — mais pixels que uma TV 4K, em cada lente.
translations.es: La pantalla del Vision Pro tiene 23 megapíxeles por ojo — más píxeles que una TV 4K, en cada lente.
translations.fr: L'écran du Vision Pro affiche 23 mégapixels par œil — plus de pixels qu'un téléviseur 4K, dans chaque lentille.
translations.de: Das Display der Vision Pro hat 23 Megapixel pro Auge — mehr Pixel als ein 4K-Fernseher, in jeder Linse.
translations.it: Il display del Vision Pro ha 23 megapixel per occhio — più pixel di una TV 4K, in ogni lente.

english: Eye tracking on Vision Pro samples at 90Hz so the cursor follows your gaze without any visible UI lag.
context: How spatial input feels seamless

translations.pt-BR: Eye tracking no Vision Pro amostra a 90Hz, então o cursor segue seu olhar sem lag visível na UI.
translations.es: El eye tracking del Vision Pro muestrea a 90Hz, así que el cursor sigue tu mirada sin lag visible en la UI.
translations.fr: Le suivi oculaire du Vision Pro échantillonne à 90Hz, donc le curseur suit ton regard sans lag visible dans l'UI.
translations.de: Das Eye-Tracking der Vision Pro tastet mit 90 Hz ab, sodass der Cursor deinem Blick ohne sichtbaren UI-Lag folgt.
translations.it: L'eye tracking del Vision Pro campiona a 90Hz, così il cursore segue il tuo sguardo senza lag visibile nell'UI.

english: visionOS shares about 80% of its codebase with iOS — RealityKit, ARKit, and the spatial scene types are the new pieces.
context: Why bringing an iOS app to Vision Pro is often quick

translations.pt-BR: visionOS compartilha cerca de 80% do codebase com iOS — RealityKit, ARKit e os spatial scene types são as peças novas.
translations.es: visionOS comparte cerca del 80% de su codebase con iOS — RealityKit, ARKit y los spatial scene types son las piezas nuevas.
translations.fr: visionOS partage environ 80% de sa base de code avec iOS — RealityKit, ARKit et les spatial scene types sont les nouveautés.
translations.de: visionOS teilt etwa 80 % seiner Codebasis mit iOS — RealityKit, ARKit und die Spatial-Scene-Typen sind die neuen Bausteine.
translations.it: visionOS condivide circa l'80% del suo codebase con iOS — RealityKit, ARKit e gli spatial scene type sono i pezzi nuovi.

english: RealityKit uses an Entity Component System architecture — the same pattern game engines like Unity have used for years.
context: How RealityKit is structured under the hood

translations.pt-BR: RealityKit usa arquitetura Entity Component System — o mesmo padrão que game engines como Unity usam há anos.
translations.es: RealityKit usa una arquitectura Entity Component System — el mismo patrón que game engines como Unity llevan años usando.
translations.fr: RealityKit utilise une architecture Entity Component System — le même pattern que des game engines comme Unity utilisent depuis des années.
translations.de: RealityKit nutzt eine Entity-Component-System-Architektur — dasselbe Muster, das Game-Engines wie Unity seit Jahren verwenden.
translations.it: RealityKit usa un'architettura Entity Component System — lo stesso pattern usato da anni dai game engine come Unity.

english: WidgetKit caches a rendered snapshot of your widget — your code only runs on timeline updates, not on every home-screen render.
context: Why widgets are cheap on battery

translations.pt-BR: WidgetKit faz cache de um snapshot renderizado do seu widget — seu código só roda em updates de timeline, não em cada render da home screen.
translations.es: WidgetKit cachea un snapshot renderizado de tu widget — tu código solo se ejecuta en updates de timeline, no en cada render de la pantalla de inicio.
translations.fr: WidgetKit met en cache un snapshot rendu de ton widget — ton code ne s'exécute que sur les updates de timeline, pas à chaque rendu de l'écran d'accueil.
translations.de: WidgetKit speichert einen gerenderten Snapshot deines Widgets im Cache — dein Code läuft nur bei Timeline-Updates, nicht bei jedem Home-Screen-Render.
translations.it: WidgetKit memorizza in cache uno snapshot renderizzato del tuo widget — il tuo codice gira solo sugli update della timeline, non a ogni render della home.

english: Live Activities update via ActivityKit push tokens — similar to remote notifications but with much lower latency for real-time UI.
context: How Dynamic Island and lock-screen activities stay live

translations.pt-BR: Live Activities atualizam via push tokens do ActivityKit — parecido com remote notifications mas com latência bem menor pra UI em tempo real.
translations.es: Las Live Activities se actualizan vía push tokens de ActivityKit — similar a las remote notifications pero con mucha menos latencia para UI en tiempo real.
translations.fr: Les Live Activities s'actualisent via les push tokens d'ActivityKit — similaire aux remote notifications mais avec une latence bien plus faible pour une UI en temps réel.
translations.de: Live Activities aktualisieren sich über ActivityKit-Push-Tokens — ähnlich wie Remote Notifications, aber mit deutlich geringerer Latenz für Echtzeit-UI.
translations.it: Le Live Activity si aggiornano tramite push token di ActivityKit — simile alle remote notification ma con latenza molto più bassa per UI in tempo reale.

english: App Intents replaces SiriKit — Intent extensions are deprecated, and the same definition now powers Siri, Shortcuts, Spotlight, and widgets.
context: Why migrating to App Intents is worth the effort

translations.pt-BR: App Intents substitui SiriKit — Intent extensions estão deprecated, e a mesma definição agora alimenta Siri, Shortcuts, Spotlight e widgets.
translations.es: App Intents reemplaza a SiriKit — las Intent extensions están deprecated, y la misma definición ahora alimenta Siri, Shortcuts, Spotlight y widgets.
translations.fr: App Intents remplace SiriKit — les Intent extensions sont dépréciées, et la même définition alimente désormais Siri, Shortcuts, Spotlight et les widgets.
translations.de: App Intents ersetzt SiriKit — Intent-Extensions sind veraltet, und dieselbe Definition versorgt jetzt Siri, Shortcuts, Spotlight und Widgets.
translations.it: App Intents sostituisce SiriKit — le Intent extension sono deprecate, e la stessa definizione ora alimenta Siri, Shortcuts, Spotlight e widget.

english: Swift evolved from LLVM — Chris Lattner started it in 2010, drawing ideas from Objective-C, Rust, Haskell, and Python.
context: Origin story of the Swift language

translations.pt-BR: Swift evoluiu do LLVM — Chris Lattner começou em 2010, puxando ideias de Objective-C, Rust, Haskell e Python.
translations.es: Swift evolucionó del LLVM — Chris Lattner lo comenzó en 2010, tomando ideas de Objective-C, Rust, Haskell y Python.
translations.fr: Swift a évolué depuis LLVM — Chris Lattner l'a commencé en 2010, en puisant des idées dans Objective-C, Rust, Haskell et Python.
translations.de: Swift entstand aus LLVM — Chris Lattner begann 2010 mit der Sprache und ließ sich von Objective-C, Rust, Haskell und Python inspirieren.
translations.it: Swift è nato da LLVM — Chris Lattner l'ha iniziato nel 2010, prendendo idee da Objective-C, Rust, Haskell e Python.

english: Swift Evolution proposals are public and community-reviewed — SE-0235 introduced the Result type, born from open discussion.
context: How language features actually ship in Swift

translations.pt-BR: Propostas do Swift Evolution são públicas e revisadas pela comunidade — a SE-0235 introduziu o tipo Result, nascida de discussão aberta.
translations.es: Las propuestas de Swift Evolution son públicas y revisadas por la comunidad — la SE-0235 introdujo el tipo Result, nacida de discusión abierta.
translations.fr: Les propositions Swift Evolution sont publiques et revues par la communauté — SE-0235 a introduit le type Result, née d'une discussion ouverte.
translations.de: Swift-Evolution-Proposals sind öffentlich und werden von der Community geprüft — SE-0235 führte den Result-Typ ein, geboren aus offener Diskussion.
translations.it: Le proposte Swift Evolution sono pubbliche e revisionate dalla community — la SE-0235 ha introdotto il tipo Result, nata da una discussione aperta.

english: Apple's Vision framework has shipped on-device OCR since iOS 13 — it now recognizes a printed page in roughly 50 ms on Apple Silicon.
context: How long on-device AI has been quietly running on iPhone

translations.pt-BR: O framework Vision da Apple entrega OCR on-device desde o iOS 13 — hoje ele reconhece uma página impressa em cerca de 50 ms no Apple Silicon.
translations.es: El framework Vision de Apple ofrece OCR on-device desde iOS 13 — ahora reconoce una página impresa en unos 50 ms en Apple Silicon.
translations.fr: Le framework Vision d'Apple propose l'OCR on-device depuis iOS 13 — il reconnaît désormais une page imprimée en environ 50 ms sur Apple Silicon.
translations.de: Apples Vision-Framework bietet On-Device-OCR seit iOS 13 — heute erkennt es eine gedruckte Seite in etwa 50 ms auf Apple Silicon.
translations.it: Il framework Vision di Apple offre OCR on-device dall'iOS 13 — oggi riconosce una pagina stampata in circa 50 ms su Apple Silicon.

english: Apple has shipped on-device transformer models for autocorrect since iOS 17 — Apple Intelligence is the next leap in that direction.
context: On-device ML has been quietly evolving for years

translations.pt-BR: A Apple já entrega transformers on-device pra autocorrect desde o iOS 17 — Apple Intelligence é o próximo salto nessa direção.
translations.es: Apple ya entrega transformers on-device para autocorrect desde iOS 17 — Apple Intelligence es el siguiente salto en esa dirección.
translations.fr: Apple livre déjà des transformeurs on-device pour la correction automatique depuis iOS 17 — Apple Intelligence est le prochain saut dans cette direction.
translations.de: Apple liefert seit iOS 17 On-Device-Transformer-Modelle für die Autokorrektur — Apple Intelligence ist der nächste Sprung in diese Richtung.
translations.it: Apple distribuisce modelli transformer on-device per l'autocorrezione fin da iOS 17 — Apple Intelligence è il prossimo salto in quella direzione.

english: Noncopyable types in Swift prevent accidental aliasing — important for resource handles, file descriptors, and one-shot tokens.
context: A modern Swift language feature for ownership

translations.pt-BR: Tipos noncopyable em Swift previnem aliasing acidental — importante pra handles de recurso, file descriptors e tokens de uso único.
translations.es: Los tipos noncopyable en Swift previenen el aliasing accidental — importante para handles de recurso, file descriptors y tokens de un solo uso.
translations.fr: Les types noncopyable de Swift empêchent l'aliasing accidentel — important pour les handles de ressources, les file descriptors et les tokens à usage unique.
translations.de: Noncopyable-Typen in Swift verhindern versehentliches Aliasing — wichtig für Ressourcen-Handles, File Descriptors und Einmal-Tokens.
translations.it: I tipi noncopyable in Swift impediscono l'aliasing accidentale — importanti per handle di risorse, file descriptor e token monouso.

english: Xcode Cloud builds on Apple Silicon — average build times dropped about 50% compared to the old Intel Mac infrastructure.
context: Why CI on Xcode Cloud feels noticeably faster

translations.pt-BR: Xcode Cloud roda em Apple Silicon — o tempo médio de build caiu cerca de 50% em relação à infraestrutura antiga em Mac Intel.
translations.es: Xcode Cloud compila en Apple Silicon — los tiempos medios de build cayeron cerca de un 50% frente a la antigua infraestructura en Mac Intel.
translations.fr: Xcode Cloud compile sur Apple Silicon — les temps de build moyens ont baissé d'environ 50% par rapport à l'ancienne infrastructure sur Mac Intel.
translations.de: Xcode Cloud baut auf Apple Silicon — die durchschnittlichen Build-Zeiten sind im Vergleich zur alten Intel-Mac-Infrastruktur um etwa 50 % gesunken.
translations.it: Xcode Cloud compila su Apple Silicon — i tempi medi di build sono scesi di circa il 50% rispetto alla vecchia infrastruttura su Mac Intel.

english: App Store Connect requires apps to disclose Apple Intelligence usage in privacy nutrition labels — reviewers reject builds that hide it.
context: Compliance requirement for AI-powered apps

translations.pt-BR: App Store Connect exige que apps declarem o uso de Apple Intelligence nos privacy nutrition labels — reviewers rejeitam builds que escondem isso.
translations.es: App Store Connect exige que las apps declaren el uso de Apple Intelligence en los privacy nutrition labels — los revisores rechazan builds que lo ocultan.
translations.fr: App Store Connect exige que les apps déclarent l'usage d'Apple Intelligence dans les privacy nutrition labels — les reviewers rejettent les builds qui le cachent.
translations.de: App Store Connect verlangt, dass Apps die Nutzung von Apple Intelligence in den Privacy Nutrition Labels offenlegen — Reviewer lehnen Builds ab, die das verbergen.
translations.it: App Store Connect richiede alle app di dichiarare l'uso di Apple Intelligence nei privacy nutrition label — i reviewer rifiutano le build che lo nascondono.

english: WWDC sessions are recorded but the developer labs are not — bring your hardest questions to a lab while the engineers are still in the room.
context: How to get the most out of WWDC week

translations.pt-BR: As sessions da WWDC são gravadas, mas os developer labs não — leva suas perguntas mais difíceis pra um lab enquanto os engenheiros ainda estão na sala.
translations.es: Las sessions de WWDC se graban, pero los developer labs no — lleva tus preguntas más difíciles a un lab mientras los ingenieros aún están en la sala.
translations.fr: Les sessions de la WWDC sont enregistrées, mais les developer labs ne le sont pas — apporte tes questions les plus difficiles à un lab tant que les ingénieurs sont encore présents.
translations.de: WWDC-Sessions werden aufgezeichnet, die Developer Labs jedoch nicht — bring deine schwierigsten Fragen in ein Lab, solange die Engineers noch im Raum sind.
translations.it: Le session del WWDC sono registrate, ma i developer lab no — porta le tue domande più difficili a un lab finché gli ingegneri sono ancora in sala.

english: Swift's compiler is fully open source — the toolchain lives on GitHub and accepts community pull requests.
context: Curiosity about Swift's openness

translations.pt-BR: O compilador do Swift é totalmente open source — a toolchain mora no GitHub e aceita pull requests da comunidade.
translations.es: El compilador de Swift es totalmente open source — la toolchain vive en GitHub y acepta pull requests de la comunidad.
translations.fr: Le compilateur Swift est entièrement open source — la toolchain est sur GitHub et accepte les pull requests de la communauté.
translations.de: Der Swift-Compiler ist vollständig Open Source — die Toolchain liegt auf GitHub und akzeptiert Pull Requests aus der Community.
translations.it: Il compilatore di Swift è completamente open source — la toolchain vive su GitHub e accetta pull request dalla community.

english: URLSession supports HTTP/3 by default on iOS 17 and later — QUIC recovers from packet loss faster than HTTP/2.
context: Performance win you get for free on modern iOS

translations.pt-BR: URLSession suporta HTTP/3 por padrão no iOS 17 e mais novos — o QUIC recupera de perda de pacote mais rápido que HTTP/2.
translations.es: URLSession soporta HTTP/3 por defecto en iOS 17 y posteriores — QUIC recupera la pérdida de paquetes más rápido que HTTP/2.
translations.fr: URLSession supporte HTTP/3 par défaut sur iOS 17 et plus — QUIC récupère plus vite des pertes de paquets que HTTP/2.
translations.de: URLSession unterstützt HTTP/3 standardmäßig ab iOS 17 — QUIC erholt sich schneller von Paketverlust als HTTP/2.
translations.it: URLSession supporta HTTP/3 di default da iOS 17 in poi — QUIC recupera dalla perdita di pacchetti più velocemente di HTTP/2.

english: StoreKit 2 returns purchases as Swift structs with verified signatures — no JSON receipt parsing or server-side validation required.
context: Why StoreKit 2 is dramatically simpler than StoreKit 1

translations.pt-BR: StoreKit 2 devolve compras como structs Swift com assinaturas verificadas — sem parsing de JSON de recibo nem validação no servidor.
translations.es: StoreKit 2 devuelve compras como structs Swift con firmas verificadas — sin parsing de JSON de recibo ni validación en el servidor.
translations.fr: StoreKit 2 renvoie les achats sous forme de structs Swift avec signatures vérifiées — pas de parsing de JSON de reçu ni de validation côté serveur.
translations.de: StoreKit 2 liefert Käufe als Swift-Structs mit verifizierten Signaturen zurück — kein Receipt-JSON-Parsing oder Server-seitige Validierung nötig.
translations.it: StoreKit 2 restituisce gli acquisti come struct Swift con firme verificate — niente parsing JSON delle ricevute né validazione server-side.

english: Sign in with Apple is privacy-preserving by design — users can hide their real email behind a per-app relay address.
context: How Apple's auth differs from third-party social login

translations.pt-BR: Sign in with Apple é privacy-preserving por design — usuários podem esconder o email real atrás de um endereço relay por app.
translations.es: Sign in with Apple es privacy-preserving por diseño — los usuarios pueden ocultar su email real detrás de una dirección relay por app.
translations.fr: Sign in with Apple est privacy-preserving par conception — les utilisateurs peuvent cacher leur vrai email derrière une adresse relay par app.
translations.de: Sign in with Apple ist von Design her datenschutzfreundlich — Nutzer können ihre echte E-Mail hinter einer Relay-Adresse pro App verstecken.
translations.it: Sign in with Apple è privacy-preserving by design — gli utenti possono nascondere la loro email reale dietro un indirizzo relay per app.

english: TestFlight supports up to 10,000 external testers per build — far more than most apps will ever need for beta validation.
context: Scale of beta testing available on Apple platforms

translations.pt-BR: TestFlight suporta até 10.000 testers externos por build — bem mais do que a maioria dos apps vai precisar pra validar um beta.
translations.es: TestFlight soporta hasta 10.000 testers externos por build — mucho más de lo que la mayoría de apps necesitarán para validar un beta.
translations.fr: TestFlight prend en charge jusqu'à 10 000 testeurs externes par build — bien plus que ce dont la plupart des apps auront besoin pour valider une bêta.
translations.de: TestFlight unterstützt bis zu 10.000 externe Tester pro Build — weit mehr als die meisten Apps für ihre Beta-Validierung jemals brauchen.
translations.it: TestFlight supporta fino a 10.000 tester esterni per build — molto più di quanto la maggior parte delle app abbia bisogno per validare una beta.

english: App Review's median response time in 2024 was around 24 hours — a decade ago the same review took about a week.
context: How dramatically App Review speed has improved

translations.pt-BR: O tempo médio de resposta do App Review em 2024 ficou em torno de 24 horas — uma década atrás a mesma revisão levava cerca de uma semana.
translations.es: El tiempo medio de respuesta del App Review en 2024 fue de unas 24 horas — hace una década la misma revisión tardaba cerca de una semana.
translations.fr: Le temps de réponse médian d'App Review en 2024 tournait autour de 24 heures — il y a dix ans, la même revue prenait environ une semaine.
translations.de: Die mediane Antwortzeit von App Review lag 2024 bei rund 24 Stunden — vor einem Jahrzehnt dauerte dieselbe Prüfung etwa eine Woche.
translations.it: Il tempo mediano di risposta dell'App Review nel 2024 si è attestato sulle 24 ore — un decennio fa la stessa revisione richiedeva circa una settimana.

english: Apple Watch Series 10 ships with the S10 SiP — the first Apple Watch chip capable of running Apple Intelligence models locally.
context: Hardware milestone for on-device AI on the wrist

translations.pt-BR: O Apple Watch Series 10 vem com o S10 SiP — o primeiro chip de Apple Watch capaz de rodar modelos do Apple Intelligence localmente.
translations.es: El Apple Watch Series 10 viene con el S10 SiP — el primer chip de Apple Watch capaz de ejecutar modelos de Apple Intelligence localmente.
translations.fr: L'Apple Watch Series 10 embarque le S10 SiP — la première puce d'Apple Watch capable d'exécuter les modèles Apple Intelligence localement.
translations.de: Die Apple Watch Series 10 kommt mit dem S10 SiP — der erste Apple-Watch-Chip, der Apple-Intelligence-Modelle lokal ausführen kann.
translations.it: L'Apple Watch Series 10 arriva con l'S10 SiP — il primo chip per Apple Watch capace di eseguire localmente i modelli di Apple Intelligence.

english: Mac Catalyst lets a single iPad app target macOS — over 60% of new App Store apps now support it without writing Mac-specific code.
context: Why bringing an iPad app to Mac is mostly free

translations.pt-BR: Mac Catalyst permite que um único app de iPad mire macOS — mais de 60% dos novos apps na App Store já suportam isso sem escrever código específico pra Mac.
translations.es: Mac Catalyst permite que una sola app de iPad apunte a macOS — más del 60% de las apps nuevas en App Store ya lo soportan sin escribir código específico para Mac.
translations.fr: Mac Catalyst permet à une app iPad unique de cibler macOS — plus de 60% des nouvelles apps de l'App Store le supportent désormais sans code spécifique au Mac.
translations.de: Mac Catalyst erlaubt es, eine einzige iPad-App auf macOS zu zielen — über 60 % der neuen App-Store-Apps unterstützen es ohne Mac-spezifischen Code.
translations.it: Mac Catalyst permette a una singola app iPad di puntare a macOS — oltre il 60% delle nuove app sull'App Store lo supporta senza scrivere codice specifico per Mac.

english: Combine is still first class, but for reactive streams new code should prefer AsyncSequence — it integrates natively with Swift Concurrency.
context: Modern recommendation for reactive Swift code

translations.pt-BR: Combine continua first class, mas pra streams reativos código novo deveria preferir AsyncSequence — ele integra nativamente com Swift Concurrency.
translations.es: Combine sigue siendo first class, pero para streams reactivos el código nuevo debería preferir AsyncSequence — se integra nativamente con Swift Concurrency.
translations.fr: Combine reste first class, mais pour les flux réactifs le nouveau code devrait préférer AsyncSequence — il s'intègre nativement avec Swift Concurrency.
translations.de: Combine bleibt First Class, doch für reaktive Streams sollte neuer Code AsyncSequence bevorzugen — es integriert sich nativ mit Swift Concurrency.
translations.it: Combine resta first class, ma per gli stream reattivi il codice nuovo dovrebbe preferire AsyncSequence — si integra nativamente con Swift Concurrency.

english: iOS Live Text recognizes 17 languages including handwritten input — it runs on the Neural Engine in real time from the Camera app.
context: Curiosity about on-device OCR scope on iPhone

translations.pt-BR: O Live Text do iOS reconhece 17 idiomas incluindo escrita à mão — roda na Neural Engine em tempo real direto da Camera app.
translations.es: El Live Text de iOS reconoce 17 idiomas, incluida la escritura a mano — se ejecuta en el Neural Engine en tiempo real desde la app Cámara.
translations.fr: Le Live Text d'iOS reconnaît 17 langues, y compris l'écriture manuscrite — il tourne sur le Neural Engine en temps réel depuis l'app Caméra.
translations.de: iOS Live Text erkennt 17 Sprachen einschließlich Handschrift — es läuft auf der Neural Engine in Echtzeit aus der Kamera-App.
translations.it: Il Live Text di iOS riconosce 17 lingue inclusa la scrittura a mano — gira sul Neural Engine in tempo reale dall'app Fotocamera.

english: Core ML models can be compiled with float16 weights — roughly half the file size with near-identical accuracy on most networks.
context: Optimization trick for shipping ML models in apps

translations.pt-BR: Modelos Core ML podem ser compilados com pesos float16 — quase metade do tamanho do arquivo com acurácia praticamente idêntica na maioria das redes.
translations.es: Los modelos Core ML pueden compilarse con pesos float16 — aproximadamente la mitad del tamaño con precisión casi idéntica en la mayoría de las redes.
translations.fr: Les modèles Core ML peuvent être compilés en poids float16 — environ la moitié de la taille de fichier pour une précision quasi identique sur la plupart des réseaux.
translations.de: Core-ML-Modelle lassen sich mit float16-Gewichten kompilieren — etwa halbe Dateigröße bei nahezu identischer Genauigkeit auf den meisten Netzwerken.
translations.it: I modelli Core ML possono essere compilati con pesi float16 — circa metà della dimensione del file con accuratezza quasi identica sulla maggior parte delle reti.

english: Metal 3 introduced MetalFX upscaling — temporal upscaling that delivers 4K visuals from a 1080p source at a fraction of the GPU cost.
context: Performance feature that game developers care about

translations.pt-BR: O Metal 3 trouxe o MetalFX upscaling — upscaling temporal que entrega visuais 4K a partir de fonte 1080p com uma fração do custo de GPU.
translations.es: Metal 3 introdujo MetalFX upscaling — un upscaling temporal que entrega visuales 4K desde una fuente 1080p con una fracción del coste de GPU.
translations.fr: Metal 3 a introduit MetalFX upscaling — un upscaling temporel qui fournit du visuel 4K à partir d'une source 1080p avec une fraction du coût GPU.
translations.de: Metal 3 brachte MetalFX-Upscaling — temporales Upscaling, das 4K-Grafik aus einer 1080p-Quelle bei einem Bruchteil der GPU-Kosten liefert.
translations.it: Metal 3 ha introdotto MetalFX upscaling — un upscaling temporale che offre visuali 4K da una sorgente 1080p a una frazione del costo GPU.

english: SwiftData uses CloudKit under the hood when you opt into iCloud sync — same backing store, far simpler API surface.
context: How SwiftData and CloudKit relate

translations.pt-BR: SwiftData usa CloudKit por baixo quando você ativa o sync com iCloud — mesma backing store, API bem mais simples.
translations.es: SwiftData usa CloudKit por debajo cuando activas la sincronización con iCloud — el mismo backing store, una API mucho más simple.
translations.fr: SwiftData utilise CloudKit en interne quand tu actives la synchro iCloud — même backing store, une API bien plus simple.
translations.de: SwiftData nutzt im Hintergrund CloudKit, sobald du iCloud-Sync aktivierst — derselbe Backing Store, deutlich einfachere API.
translations.it: SwiftData usa CloudKit sotto il cofano quando attivi la sync con iCloud — stesso backing store, API molto più semplice.

english: Swift Charts ships an entire grammar-of-graphics framework in just a few hundred lines of public API — most charts take under 10 lines.
context: Why Swift Charts is unusually concise

translations.pt-BR: Swift Charts entrega um framework inteiro de grammar of graphics em só algumas centenas de linhas de API pública — a maioria dos gráficos sai em menos de 10 linhas.
translations.es: Swift Charts ofrece un framework completo de grammar of graphics en solo unos cientos de líneas de API pública — la mayoría de los gráficos cabe en menos de 10 líneas.
translations.fr: Swift Charts livre un framework entier de grammar of graphics en quelques centaines de lignes d'API publique seulement — la plupart des graphiques tiennent en moins de 10 lignes.
translations.de: Swift Charts liefert ein komplettes Grammar-of-Graphics-Framework in nur einigen Hundert Zeilen öffentlicher API — die meisten Diagramme passen in unter 10 Zeilen.
translations.it: Swift Charts offre un intero framework grammar of graphics in poche centinaia di righe di API pubblica — la maggior parte dei grafici sta in meno di 10 righe.

english: ARKit's scene reconstruction now classifies furniture automatically — couches, desks, and shelves are tagged so apps can react contextually.
context: Smarter spatial understanding for AR apps

translations.pt-BR: A reconstrução de cena do ARKit já classifica móveis automaticamente — sofás, mesas e prateleiras são marcados pra que apps reajam de forma contextual.
translations.es: La reconstrucción de escena de ARKit ya clasifica muebles automáticamente — sofás, escritorios y estantes se etiquetan para que las apps reaccionen contextualmente.
translations.fr: La reconstruction de scène d'ARKit classe désormais les meubles automatiquement — canapés, bureaux et étagères sont taggés pour que les apps réagissent contextuellement.
translations.de: Die Szenenrekonstruktion von ARKit klassifiziert Möbel jetzt automatisch — Sofas, Schreibtische und Regale werden markiert, damit Apps kontextuell reagieren können.
translations.it: La ricostruzione di scena di ARKit ora classifica i mobili automaticamente — divani, scrivanie e mensole vengono etichettati così le app possono reagire in modo contestuale.

english: Background tasks on iOS have a hard wall-clock budget of about 30 seconds — design any background work to finish well inside that window.
context: Critical constraint for designing background features

translations.pt-BR: Background tasks no iOS têm um budget de wall-clock de cerca de 30 segundos — desenha qualquer trabalho em background pra terminar bem dentro dessa janela.
translations.es: Las background tasks en iOS tienen un budget wall-clock de unos 30 segundos — diseña cualquier trabajo en background para terminar bien dentro de esa ventana.
translations.fr: Les background tasks d'iOS disposent d'un budget wall-clock d'environ 30 secondes — conçois tout travail en arrière-plan pour finir largement dans cette fenêtre.
translations.de: Background Tasks unter iOS haben ein hartes Wall-Clock-Budget von rund 30 Sekunden — plane jede Hintergrundarbeit so, dass sie deutlich innerhalb dieses Fensters fertig wird.
translations.it: Le background task su iOS hanno un budget wall-clock di circa 30 secondi — progetta qualsiasi lavoro in background per finire ben dentro quella finestra.

english: Swift Package Manager resolves a 10,000-package dependency graph in under two seconds — fast enough that you barely notice it on cold builds.
context: How fast SPM has become at dependency resolution

translations.pt-BR: Swift Package Manager resolve um grafo de 10.000 pacotes em menos de dois segundos — rápido o suficiente pra você nem perceber em builds frios.
translations.es: Swift Package Manager resuelve un grafo de 10.000 paquetes en menos de dos segundos — lo bastante rápido para que apenas lo notes en builds en frío.
translations.fr: Swift Package Manager résout un graphe de 10 000 paquets en moins de deux secondes — assez rapide pour qu'on le remarque à peine sur des builds à froid.
translations.de: Swift Package Manager löst einen Abhängigkeitsgraphen mit 10.000 Paketen in unter zwei Sekunden auf — schnell genug, dass man es bei Cold Builds kaum bemerkt.
translations.it: Swift Package Manager risolve un grafo di 10.000 pacchetti in meno di due secondi — abbastanza veloce da non notarlo quasi sui build a freddo.

english: Apple Wallet supports digital car keys with Ultra Wideband — the phone unlocks the car without leaving your pocket.
context: Curiosity about Wallet and UWB integration

translations.pt-BR: Apple Wallet suporta chaves digitais de carro com Ultra Wideband — o celular destrava o carro sem sair do seu bolso.
translations.es: Apple Wallet soporta llaves digitales de coche con Ultra Wideband — el teléfono desbloquea el coche sin salir de tu bolsillo.
translations.fr: Apple Wallet prend en charge les clés de voiture numériques en Ultra Wideband — le téléphone déverrouille la voiture sans sortir de ta poche.
translations.de: Apple Wallet unterstützt digitale Autoschlüssel mit Ultra Wideband — das Handy entriegelt das Auto, ohne deine Tasche zu verlassen.
translations.it: Apple Wallet supporta le chiavi digitali per auto con Ultra Wideband — il telefono sblocca l'auto senza uscire dalla tua tasca.

english: The WWDC tradition started in 1983 — Steve Jobs presented at the very first one, focused on Lisa and the original Macintosh.
context: Origin story of WWDC itself

translations.pt-BR: A tradição da WWDC começou em 1983 — Steve Jobs apresentou na primeiríssima edição, focada no Lisa e no Macintosh original.
translations.es: La tradición de WWDC empezó en 1983 — Steve Jobs presentó en la primerísima edición, centrada en el Lisa y el Macintosh original.
translations.fr: La tradition de la WWDC a commencé en 1983 — Steve Jobs a présenté lors de la toute première édition, centrée sur le Lisa et le Macintosh original.
translations.de: Die WWDC-Tradition begann 1983 — Steve Jobs präsentierte auf der allerersten Ausgabe, im Mittelpunkt standen Lisa und der originale Macintosh.
translations.it: La tradizione del WWDC è iniziata nel 1983 — Steve Jobs presentò alla primissima edizione, incentrata su Lisa e sul Macintosh originale.
